finding.recommended_fix: Separate passive expired-value destruction from generation-revoking explicit clear. An expired displayed grant must immediately drop prompt/advice/chat, while an already issued same-scope read may finish and publish only if its own fresh permission and all scope/generation/phase/epoch guards pass. Explicit revoke/bind/disconnect/Stop/Other/identity changes must continue cancelling old reads.
